description: Fast transformation format that shows the painful old workflow, the project intervention, and the improved result.
recommended_use: Projects with a credible visible delta. The split-screen contrast carries the message; weak or invisible deltas make the format feel forced. Best for tools that meaningfully change a workflow or output.
reference_notes: Show the after/result first, then rewind to the before state.
The viewer should understand the transformation without audio.
Use split-screen or hard visual contrast between before and after.
Works best when the project has a visible output, faster workflow, or cleaner interface.
Do not exaggerate factual performance improvements without source data.

composition_rules: Before and after states must be visually distinct.
Use exact labels rendered in assembly, not generated text.
Put the result in frame within the first two seconds.
Keep the comparison simple enough to read on mute.

caption_treatment.style: bold contrast captions plus deterministic BEFORE/AFTER labels

default_routes.hook: real after-state capture or deterministic result card
default_routes.before: real capture, screenshot, or deterministic dramatization clearly labeled as workflow pain
default_routes.after: real capture or source-backed result card

fallback_routes.no_real_after: do not use this style for the project
